caption: The drawing depicts a jewelry set comprising a necklace and a pair of earrings, all made of dark, braided or woven material with golden accents. The necklace features a central gold clasp and a pendant consisting of a gold fitting holding three elements: a cross, an anchor, and a heart, each adorned with the same dark braided material and small gold details. The earrings have hook-style fastenings and teardrop-shaped pendants also made of the dark braided material capped with gold. In the upper left and right corners, there are two small diagrams showing the woven pattern of the material, consisting of black or dark brown interlacing thread. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's name "D.G. Campbell" is inscribed in faint text in the lower left quadrant of the image.
title: Hair Jewelry
